Hi Alex,

Thanks again for scheduling the demo for Redwood Inference on Thu, Jun 11 at 10am PT. I need to flag that Procurement and Security have put a hold on live demos that involve any customer data or custom integrations until we complete vendor onboarding.

Two quick items from our side:
- We need an executed NDA before any environment-level demos.
- Our security team requires the vendor questionnaire completed (they can accept a preliminary copy prior to the demo but prefer it done first).

Given that procurement is out this week for travel, can we pause/reschedule the live demo until those gating steps are complete? If you can do a high-level product tour that avoids any customer data or tenant-level access, we could still do that earlier - otherwise we'll need to move the hands-on demo.

Sorry for the last-minute change. Please advise on next steps and available windows once the NDA/questionnaire are in place.

Options that could work depending on how you want to proceed:
1) We can do a high-level product tour on Thu that is purely demo data (no tenant access, no uploads). This is typically 30-45 minutes and doesn't require an NDA.
2) If you prefer the hands-on integration/demo, we should reschedule to a date after the NDA and the questionnaire are in place.

I've CC'd Marissa (SE) and Neha (Security) so they can weigh in on what they need from Acme to unblock the full demo. If you already have the DocuSign link for the NDA, send it over and we'll get that signed today. Also happy to send our standard vendor onboarding questionnaire to speed things up.

Would you like me to tentatively hold a couple of windows next week (Jun 15-17) while procurement finishes travel?
